method.method: Read-only diagnostic over two unchanged genuine MDB fixtures. Three temporary projection translation units instrument the fixed before/stage1/stage2 sources; common supporting reader library frozen once. No parser rules or production hooks. Counts captured immediately after ordinary projection, before diagnostic-only helper queries. Full graph/projection/evidence fingerprints, per-object property pointer-index choices and ordered diagnostics compared. Cancellation is deterministically triggered using borrowed external atomic at two specified boundaries; no timing or memory claims.
limits: One genuine fixture family; production full-suite/full-corpus proofs are separate.
Cancellation checkpoints are instrumented solely in temporary copied translation units; this is a control of execution, not a corrupt-file interpretation or new recovery rule.
Mid-traversal case checks acquired ordered components and no cache publication; wall-clock partial scan inventories can naturally differ when execution is faster.

Property choice proof exercises every actual Latin-1 property name singly and the existing ObjID/OOBJ:ObjClass alias group; unchanged graph hash plus identical pointer indices establish selected-property provenance for those queries.
The instrumentation and hash diagnostics add work and are unsuitable for speed/RAM measurements.

The chosen genuine cancellation/empty owners emit no reference diagnostics, so these controls compare empty ordered diagnostic lists. Full projection fingerprints include all diagnostic content/order; existing unresolved-reference tests and the separate full-corpus proof cover error-path diagnostics.

controls.partial: External flag is set after exactly two appended objects while work remains pending. Existing next-iteration cancellation returns that ordered component prefix; helper records the returned prefix and cache state.
controls.preinsert: External flag is set immediately before the cache publication guard; computed associations are still returned but no entry may be stored.
controls.empty: A genuine active mob with a finished empty association is queried twice; second Stage 2 query must hit cache and perform no component traversal.
controls.cached-cancel: A complete lookup first populates cache; cancellation is then set before its next request. Cached handles must not be returned.

method.expectedInstrumentationDifference: For cached-cancel, baseline/stage1 enter components and record an empty cancelled prefix, while Stage 2 stops at its entry cancellation guard before components. Returned vectors and diagnostics match; this instrumentation-only partialRecorded flag is intentionally excluded from cross-version equality.

countDefinitions.propertiesCalls: Temporary QVector instances constructed by properties(), including empty results; direct unique/uniqueRaw loops are not counted here.
countDefinitions.propertySlotsScanned: Sum of object.properties.size() only at properties() entry. After Stage 1 this excludes properties inspected by direct unique/uniqueRaw loops; it is not a total property-visit count across implementations.
countDefinitions.nonemptyTemporaryPropertyLists: All nonempty properties() result vectors; this counts vector instances, not allocator calls or allocation bytes.
countDefinitions.nonemptyUniqueTemporaryLists: Nonempty properties() vectors specifically materialized by unique(). Zero after Stage 1.
countDefinitions.nonemptyUniqueRawTemporaryLists: Nonempty properties() vectors specifically materialized by uniqueRaw(). Zero after Stage 1.
countDefinitions.componentComputes: Actual components traversal computations: components() before/Stage 1, collectComponents() in Stage 2. Wrapper calls that do not compute are excluded.
countDefinitions.sourceMobsCalls: All sourceMobs() requests, including Stage 2 cache hits.
countDefinitions.sourceMobsCacheHits: Requests answered by constFind cache entry after the entry cancellation guard.
countDefinitions.sourceMobsCacheInserts: Finished lookup publications that pass the final cancellation guard; includes finished empty results.
